name: Adds a new member to a project.
description: Adds a new member to a project. Adds a new member to the project. POST /v1/projects/{idOrName}/members
context:
POST /v1/projects/{idOrName}/members
Adds a new member to the project.
Required: idOrName (path) — The ID or name of the Project.; body (body)
Optional: teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

name: List project members
description: List project members Lists all members of a project. GET /v1/projects/{idOrName}/members
context:
GET /v1/projects/{idOrName}/members
Lists all members of a project.
Required: idOrName (path) — The ID or name of the Project.
Optional: limit (query) — Limit how many project members should be returned; since (query) — Timestamp in milliseconds to only include members added since then.; until (query) — Timestamp in milliseconds to only include members added until then.; search (query) — Search project members by their name, username, and email.; teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

name: Remove a Project Member
description: Remove a Project Member Remove a member from a specific project DELETE /v1/projects/{idOrName}/members/{uid}
context:
DELETE /v1/projects/{idOrName}/members/{uid}
Remove a member from a specific project
Required: idOrName (path) — The ID or name of the Project.; uid (path) — The user ID of the member.
Optional: teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.
